playstyle.identity: Warwick is a sustain-heavy jungler who hunts low-health enemies. His blood scent reveals and speeds him toward wounded targets, making him excellent at chasing.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive heals on autos (more at low HP). Q lunges and heals (hold to follow dashes/flashes). W senses low HP enemies globally, giving speed. E fears enemies around you. R leaps in a line, suppressing first champion hit. Hunt wounded enemies with W speed, R to catch.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Warwick spikes early with dueling and at 6 with engage. Titanic Hydra or tank items work. He's strong early-mid at chasing.

passive.name: Eternal Hunger
passive.summary: Auto attacks heal; heals more at low health.
passive.details: Warwick's basic attacks heal him. The healing increases when Warwick is low on health.

abilities.name: Jaws of the Beast
abilities.summary: Lunge and bite; hold to follow the enemy's movement.
abilities.details: Warwick lunges at an enemy, dealing damage and healing himself. Holding the button makes Warwick follow the target if they dash or flash.

abilities.name: Blood Hunt
abilities.summary: Sense low health enemies globally; gain speed toward them.
abilities.details: Passive: Warwick senses enemies below 50% health globally, gaining movement speed toward them. Active: The next hunt triggers on any enemy.

abilities.name: Primal Howl
abilities.summary: Reduce damage taken; recast or wait to fear nearby enemies.
abilities.details: Warwick howls, gaining damage reduction. After a duration or on recast, he fears all nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Infinite Duress
abilities.summary: Leap forward and suppress the first champion hit.
abilities.details: Warwick leaps in a direction, suppressing the first champion hit and dealing damage over time while healing himself.
